segments.ja384:1.1: Dhammaṃ caratha ñātayo, dhammaṃ caratha bhaddaṃ vo [bhadda vo (ka.)];
segments.ja384:1.3: Dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
segments.ja384:3.3: Bhutvā aṇḍañca potañca [chāpe ca (sī. pī.)], dhammo dhammoti bhāsati.
segments.ja384:4.1: Aññaṃ bhaṇati vācāya, aññaṃ kāyena kubbati;
segments.ja384:4.3: Vācāya no ca kāyena, na taṃ dhammaṃ adhiṭṭhito.
segments.ja384:5.1: Vācāya sakhilo manoviduggo, channo kūpasayova kaṇhasappo;
segments.ja384:5.3: Dhammadhajo gāmanigamāsusādhu [gāmanigamāsu sādhusammato (sī.), gāmanigamasādhu (pī.)], dujjāno purisena bālisena.
segments.ja384:6.1: Imaṃ tuṇḍehi pakkhehi, pādā cimaṃ viheṭhatha [vipothatha (pī.)];
